name: Meprednisone
summary: For Meprednisone, the available data does not list any warning signs, past problems, or regulatory warnings [1][2]. A small computer model, not tests on people, gave the medicine a score of 8 in the low band for the liver [M]. The same computer model also gave the drug a score of 17 in the low band for the heart [M]. There are no recorded clinical trials or comparison drugs provided to report other warning signs [1][2].
